title: Mazana Mapfumbamwe Emakore Ekudanwa
intro: Fungidzira wakamira wega uchitarisana nedutu rekushorwa kwenguva yakareba kupfuura umambo hunomuka nekuwa, uchidanidzira husiku nemasikati nzeve dzakavharwa uye mbatya dzakadhonzwa zvakasimba. Mberi kune ngarava yakavakwa panyika yakaoma nemvura isina kumbobvira yamboonekwa. Unonzwa here kushivirira kuri shure kwekukokwa uku?
clues: Ndakakoka vanhu vangu husiku nemasikati, muchivande uye pachena, kuti vanamate Allah chete.
Vanhu vangu vanoisa minwe munzeve dzavo uye vanozviputira nenguo kuti vandifuratire.
Ndakagara pakati pevanhu vangu kwemakore mazana mapfumbamwe nemakumi mashanu ndichivadana kuti vatungamire.
Ndakavaka mudziyo pasi pemaziso aAllah neruzivo rwake apo vanhu vangu vaindiseka panyika yakaoma.
Ndakarayirwa kutakura mapeya emhando dzose muchikepe uye vatendi pakasvika murairo uye ovheni yazara.
Ndakaona mafungu achikwira semakomo apo mafashamo akanyudza avo vakaramba, ukuwo Allah akaponesa avo vaiva muAreka.

arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّى دَعَوْتُ قَوْمِى لَيْلًۭا وَنَهَارًۭا
verse: He said, "My Lord, indeed I invited my people [to truth] night and day. (71:5)
